entries.file: extractOoxmlText(path of a file named filename, { maxOutputBytes })
entries.lowered: officeTextForFile({ data, filename }) of media-normalization.mjs (256 KiB output, 8 MiB part and 32 MiB container caps)
entries.try: tryExtractOoxmlTextFromBuffer(bytes, filename, { maxOutputBytes, maxPartBytes, maxContainerBytes }); null where the bytes have no text form

exclusions: a lone surrogate written as a numeric reference (�): Node keeps it in the JavaScript string and encodes it as U+FFFD when the text is written out; a Rust string cannot hold one, so the core writes U+FFFD at the reference. Not recorded.
a container of more than 50 MiB (OFFICE_MAX_BYTES) and a stored entry above the 32 MiB part cap: too large to keep as a fixture; the crate tests build them in memory.
extractOoxmlText on a missing or unreadable file: the message names the operating system error and the path of the machine; the crate tests compare its shape.

product.tree: the Node modules the recorder loaded, by sha256 (the tree is read only; no file of it changes)
